opening.argument: The presentation promotes a BitClub cryptocurrency opportunity by soliciting payment for mining-pool shares, including a $99 entry and a $2,000 share described as paying for a thousand days of mining. It presents daily profits continuing for years and adds compensation for recruiting new members who buy shares: “You can get paid for referring new Bit Club Members.” That combination of upfront payment, easy-profit claims, and recruitment-based compensation supports the alleged paid mining or node-return scheme. The available evidence does not establish whether mining operations, payments, or profits actually existed, so the claim concerns the structure and promises of the offer rather than proven financial outcomes.
